## Summary
- Add an install request issue template for public target repository URLs.
- Have install publish add source request links to target PR bodies and update reused PR bodies.
- Close issue-backed install requests through a typed best-effort CLI after the install response posts.
- Update install docs, README, prompt guidance, and focused tests.

## Verification
- `npm --prefix .agent run build`
- `node --test .agent/dist/__tests__/install-fork-pr.test.js .agent/dist/__tests__/install-fork-pr-cli.test.js .agent/dist/__tests__/install-request.test.js .agent/dist/__tests__/envelope.test.js`
- `git diff --check`

Closes #303

comments.body: @sepo-agent /answer why this is way much larger than https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/pull/293 ?

Short version: #304 is larger because it is not just the same #293 patch rebased. It is a fresh implementation after #298 merged, and it incorporates the review feedback from #293: move the fragile inline workflow parsing/closing logic into typed, tested `.agent/src` code.

Concrete size drivers:

- #293 was 9 files, `+79/-10`. It mostly added the issue template/docs plus inline shell in `agent-router.yml` that grepped the response body for a marker/PR URL and closed the issue.
- #304 is 16 files, `+497/-6`. The extra bulk is mostly:
  - new typed close helper: [`install-request.ts`](https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/blob/1610f81f107ae2eb798f17f47b7a584bd77c12c1/.agent/src/install-request.ts#L79-L175)
  - new CLI wrapper: [`complete-install-request.ts`](https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/blob/1610f81f107ae2eb798f17f47b7a584bd77c12c1/.agent/src/cli/complete-install-request.ts#L1-L53)
  - focused lifecycle tests: [`install-request.test.ts`](https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/blob/1610f81f107ae2eb798f17f47b7a584bd77c12c1/.agent/src/__tests__/install-request.test.ts#L1)
  - structured publish outputs instead of parsing markdown from the agent response: [`agent-router.yml`](https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/blob/1610f81f107ae2eb798f17f47b7a584bd77c12c1/.github/workflows/agent-router.yml#L710-L726)
  - source request link support in the install PR body, including reused PRs: [`install-fork-pr.ts`](https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/blob/1610f81f107ae2eb798f17f47b7a584bd77c12c1/.agent/src/install-fork-pr.ts#L168-L200)

The main reason is the acceptance criteria in #303 explicitly asked to recreate #293 after #298 and avoid “brittle inline workflow shell and markdown-wide regex parsing” by using the typed helper/CLI style. So #304 is larger because it pays for validation, idempotency, non-fatal cleanup, structured outputs, and regression tests.

- The strongest rubric alignment is that PR #304 follows issue #303’s explicit instruction to move lifecycle parsing/closure out of workflow shell and into typed `.agent/src` helpers with focused tests.

> Dual-agent review by **Claude** and **Codex**.

## Summary of PR/Issue
- PR #304 implements issue #303 by recreating the install request issue-template flow on top of the merged first-class `/install` route from #298.
- It adds a public install request issue form, carries the source request link into published or reused target install PR bodies, and closes source request issues best-effort after the install response posts.
- The PR replaces the earlier #293-style workflow parsing with typed `.agent/src` helper/CLI code and structured publish outputs.
- Current CI for head `f4e94a9c` is passing.

## Review
No blocking issues are supported by the current review artifacts or live PR state. Claude raised two minor follow-up concerns; Codex and the rubrics review both found the implementation acceptable, so these are best treated as maintainer-choice polish rather than required automation work.

| Issue | Severity | Description |
| -- | -- | -- |
| Missing `issue_state_unavailable` regression test | WARNING | [`completeInstallRequest`](https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/blob/f4e94a9cf73e6ab7b4784e42508e6cc1a17f45d0/.agent/src/install-request.ts#L111-L121) handles `gh issue view` failures, but the new test file does not exercise `runner.failView`. |
| Install credential discoverability is reduced | WARNING | The PR intentionally moves `AGENT_INSTALL_PAT` out of the public configuration list and into developer notes; that keeps target-repo docs simpler, but may make source-repo self-hosted install setup less discoverable. |
| Review lanes otherwise agree on the design direction | INFO | The implementation satisfies #303’s typed-helper requirement and current rubrics review scored PASS with no required follow-up. |

## Progress
- Reviewed PR #304, linked issue #303, prior PR #293 feedback, and the merged #298 install-route context.
- Existing inline review comments and review threads are empty for PR #304.
- No inline comments were posted, no replies were added, and no comments or threads were minimized/resolved.
- `gh pr checks 304` reports the current `check` job passing.

## Issue Details

<details>
<summary>Missing `issue_state_unavailable` regression test</summary>

**Cause:** The fake runner in [`install-request.test.ts`](https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/blob/f4e94a9cf73e6ab7b4784e42508e6cc1a17f45d0/.agent/src/__tests__/install-request.test.ts#L8-L24) exposes `failView`, and production code returns `failed` / `issue_state_unavailable`, but the focused tests cover close success, non-issue/non-published skips, already-closed skip, and close failure only.

**Candidate solutions:** Add one small test setting `runner.failView = true` and asserting `status === "failed"` plus `reason === "issue_state_unavailable"`.

**Comments:** Claude flagged this as a warning. Codex considered the existing coverage sufficient, so this is useful hardening but not a blocker.

</details>

<details>
<summary>Install credential discoverability is reduced</summary>

**Cause:** [`configuration-list.md`](https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/blob/f4e94a9cf73e6ab7b4784e42508e6cc1a17f45d0/.agent/docs/customization/configuration-list.md#L39-L49) no longer names `AGENT_INSTALL_PAT`; [`install-existing-repository.md`](https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/blob/f4e94a9cf73e6ab7b4784e42508e6cc1a17f45d0/.agent/docs/deployment/install-existing-repository.md#L34-L44) describes a dedicated install credential without the secret name, while developer notes now carry the internal name.

**Candidate solutions:** Either leave as-is to keep first-run docs audience-first, or add a short cross-reference from the install docs/config list to the developer note for operators running their own Sepo source repository.

**Comments:** This is a documentation audience trade-off, not an implementation defect. The rubrics review passed `audience-first-documentation`.

</details>

## Recommended Next Step
`HUMAN_DECISION`: the only remaining concerns are optional coverage/docs polish and need maintainer preference before more automation.

## Final Verdict
MINOR_ISSUES

title: Add issue-backed install request lifecycle
